# Objects without DWARF: start address (vram), unit, compiler, source.
# Generated by tools/nodwarf.py from the STT_FILE symbols (local
# functions and names) and the module's .comment version.
0x003E8 WaterPatch      1.6.1.internal  WaterPatch.cpp
0x02D3C main            1.6.1.internal  main.cpp
# main.cpp's range holds ~120 C++ objects (only the first has an STT_FILE
# symbol): each starts with its __static_initialization_and_destruction_0
# (GCC 3.3 emits it first; its _GLOBAL__I_/_GLOBAL__D_ and the weak template
# instances it is the first to need follow the object's functions), or, for an
# object without static constructors, with the first non-weak function after
# such a run.  Names are made up from the constructor's key function.
# With main split, the units' references would split .rodata by unit, which
# the units' C (written against one asm blob) doesn't follow yet: keep it whole.
